The '''father''' of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Guun Han Saresh]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. To commemorate his son's acceptance into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he commissioned the creation of the powerful [[Circlet of Saresh/Legends|Circlet of Saresh]], as a gift for Guun Han.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic" />
